# NONoise

> AI SDLC bootstrapper. The `create-nonoise` CLI scaffolds projects with AI skills, a docs hierarchy, per-tool context files and the Polly orchestrator, and upgrades existing ones.

## For agents asked to install or update NONoise in a project

- [UPDATE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/UPDATE.md): step-by-step runbook (detect case, `npx create-nonoise@latest --upgrade <path>`, `doctor`, post-upgrade steps)

## Docs

- [Installation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/docs/installation.md)
- [Install profiles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/docs/install-profiles.md)
- [Contributor guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/CLAUDE.md)
